blocks.text: Setting up your Notion workspace on Mac

The Notion desktop app requires macOS 13 or later. Download it from the official site. Once installed, log in with your corporate credentials. Use the Notion menu in the top menu bar to check for updates. If the app feels sluggish, press ⌘ R to reload the workspace. This forces a fresh sync of your databases.

A technical account manager needs a master database for accounts. Use the /database command to create a new inline table. Add properties for status, next renewal date, and technical contact. You can filter these views by status to see only active accounts. Use the filter icon in the top right of your database to hide completed projects.
Practical tips for technical account management

items: Create a template for onboarding documents to ensure consistency across clients.
Use callouts to highlight urgent technical blockers at the top of a page.
Embed your technical roadmap using the /embed command for live updates.
Use toggles to hide complex technical specs while keeping the page clean.
Set reminders for renewal dates using the @ symbol followed by a date.

blocks.text: Technical documentation often gets messy. Use the table of contents feature to help stakeholders find information quickly. If a page becomes too long, break it into sub-pages. You can drag and drop blocks between pages to reorganize content. Always lock your final documentation pages using the menu in the top right corner to prevent accidental edits.

Do not put all your client communication in one giant text block. It becomes impossible to search. Instead, use a database with tags for different types of updates. Avoid deep nesting pages more than three levels down. It makes navigation difficult when you are in a rush. If you get lost, use ⌘ P to open the search bar and find your page by name.
Speed up your workflow with Lazur

Lazur helps you stay focused while you manage technical details. When you need to find a specific setting in Notion, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask. Lazur circles the button or menu item on your screen. When you need to draft a technical summary, hold fn and dictate your notes. Lazur types them out cleanly at your cursor.

Start by auditing your current Notion workspace. Archive old projects that are no longer active. Create a standard template for your client meetings. Once you have a structure, use your voice to update status fields in real time. This keeps your data accurate without taking your hands off the keyboard.

faq.question: Can I use Notion offline on my Mac?
faq.answer: Notion requires an internet connection to sync your data. It does not have a robust offline mode for editing databases.

faq.question: How do I find my keyboard shortcuts in Notion?
faq.answer: Press ⇧ ? on your Mac while in the Notion desktop app. This opens the full list of shortcuts.

faq.question: Is Notion AI safe for client data?
faq.answer: Check the Notion privacy policy for details on how your data is handled. Lazur does not store your content or use it to train AI models.
